title: Lash and Brow Studio Tax Filing in Canada: Business Tax Returns, Expenses & Filing Requirements

rows.section: What Lash and Brow Studio Tax Filing Is (Corporations paragraph)
rows.before: Corporations follow different rules from individuals and get the small business deduction under section 125 on the first $500,000 of active business income, roughly 12.2% in Ontario against 26.5% above it.
rows.after: Corporations follow different rules from individuals and get the small business deduction under section 125 on the first $500,000 of active business income, roughly 11.2% (12.2% before July 1, 2026) in Ontario against 26.5% above it.
rows.note: 12.2% stated as current combined Ontario small business rate; 11.2% from July 1, 2026. First R1 change on page: parenthetical added.

rows.section: People Also Ask: Should the studio incorporate?
rows.before: A corporation gets the small business deduction under section 125 at roughly 12.2% in Ontario, which is a real deferral if you leave money in.
rows.after: A corporation gets the small business deduction under section 125 at roughly 11.2% in Ontario, which is a real deferral if you leave money in.
rows.note: 12.2% stated as current combined Ontario small business rate; 11.2% from July 1, 2026.

page_note: All 12.2% occurrences are current-rate R1. No 3.2%, 0.122/0.032, $600,000/$600K or 12.2%-derived dollar figures found. No 12.2% in this post's JSON-LD.
